passage: Early naturalists assumed that cuckoo chicks, which are raised by birds of other species, simply benefit at their hosts' expense. Recent work on crows in Spain complicates that view. Crow nests containing a cuckoo chick were more likely to survive attacks by predators, because the chick releases a foul-smelling substance when disturbed. ______ in years with many predators, hosting a cuckoo may actually help the crows.
stem: Which choice completes the text with the most logical transition?
steps: The sentence before gives a benefit: nests with cuckoos survived predators more often.
The blank sentence draws the conclusion from that: hosting a cuckoo may help.
“Nevertheless” signals contrast, “Similarly” a parallel, and “For instance” an example.
key: A conclusion drawn from the previous sentence takes a cause-and-effect transition.
